Content Delivery Network — serve from the edge, not the origin

A CDN is a globally distributed network of edge servers. Requests go to the nearest PoP (Point of Presence) rather than a central origin. SAP delivers Fiori UI assets from 200+ Cloudfront PoPs — a user in Tokyo gets assets from Tokyo, not the Frankfurt origin. TTFB dropped from 420 ms → 18 ms. LCP improved by 800 ms.

What CDNs deliver
  • 📦 Static assets (JS, CSS, fonts, images)
  • 🚀 Edge-cached API responses
  • 🔁 Server-Side Rendered HTML (Next.js ISR)
  • 🌩️ Edge functions (middleware, A/B, auth)
  • 📡 Streaming video / large files
Key CDN benefits
  • ⚡ Reduced latency (geographically closer)
  • ♻️ Cache hit avoids origin entirely
  • 🛡️ DDoS absorption at the edge
  • 🗜️ Automatic compression (gzip/brotli)
  • 🔒 TLS termination at edge (faster handshake)

Cache-Control headers for CDN caching

Immutable assets (JS/CSS with hash)
Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable
Content-hashed filenames (main.abc123.js). Cache forever — the hash changes = new URL. CDN and browser both cache. No conditional requests.
HTML / index.html
Cache-Control: no-cache
Must revalidate on every request — this is the entry point referencing hashed assets. ETag allows 304 Not Modified response (no body transfer) if unchanged.
API responses (vary per user)
Cache-Control: private, max-age=60, stale-while-revalidate=30
Private = CDN won't cache user data. SWR = serve stale then revalidate in background (fast UX). Or use CDN surrogate-key based invalidation for public API caches.

CDN configuration patterns

# ─── nginx: serve with proper cache headers ───
location ~* \.(js|css|woff2)$ {
  add_header Cache-Control "public, max-age=31536000, immutable";
  gzip_static on;
  brotli_static on;
}

location = /index.html {
  add_header Cache-Control "no-cache";
  add_header Vary "Accept-Encoding";
}

# ─── Cloudfront behaviour (CDK) ───
new Distribution(this, 'SAPFioriCDN', {
  defaultBehavior: {
    origin: new S3Origin(assetsBucket),
    cachePolicy: CachePolicy.CACHING_OPTIMIZED,
    compress: true,
    allowedMethods: AllowedMethods.ALLOW_GET_HEAD,
  },
  additionalBehaviors: {
    '/api/*': {
      origin: new HttpOrigin(apiDomain),
      cachePolicy: CachePolicy.CACHING_DISABLED,
      allowedMethods: AllowedMethods.ALLOW_ALL,
    },
  },
});

// ─── Next.js: CDN cache headers via next.config ───
module.exports = {
  async headers() {
    return [{
      source: '/_next/static/(.*)',
      headers: [{ key: 'Cache-Control', value: 'public, max-age=31536000, immutable' }],
    }];
  },
};
